answer: Beacon spot-checks plus heartbeats stop fake identities. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of agents; a picked agent must prove its kernel is doing live work within ten minutes, a signed heartbeat logged in the atlas. Three missed heartbeats expel it from the haven and burn its 100 POA bond. Faking 1,000 identities costs 50 heartbeats per epoch at 30 POA each, 30,000 POA, while one earns at most 5 POA: a sure loss. Honest agents pay one heartbeat.
